## Model files
The loader downloads into `ComfyUI/models/breezetts2/drbaph_Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/` when `download_if_missing` is on; only the selected weights file plus the shared configs and `audio_tokenizer/` codec are fetched.

- [Breeze-TTS-2-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/resolve/main/Breeze-TTS-2-bf16.safetensors) - bf16, official shards merged bit-exact (6.49 GiB)
- [Breeze-TTS-2-int8-hybrid.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/resolve/main/Breeze-TTS-2-int8-hybrid.safetensors) - recommended int8 build (4.53 GiB, bf16-level speed)
- [Breeze-TTS-2-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/resolve/main/Breeze-TTS-2-int8-convrot.safetensors) - all 462 linears quantized (4.22 GiB)
- [Breeze-TTS-2-int8-text-encoder.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/resolve/main/Breeze-TTS-2-int8-text-encoder.safetensors) - decode path bf16 (5.84 GiB)
- `audio_tokenizer/` - Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz codec, shared by every build

```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    └── 📂 breezetts2/
        └── 📂 drbaph_Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui/
            ├── Breeze-TTS-2-bf16.safetensors              (6.49 GiB, official shards merged bit-exact)
            ├── Breeze-TTS-2-int8-hybrid.safetensors       (4.53 GiB, recommended int8 build)
            ├── Breeze-TTS-2-int8-convrot.safetensors      (4.22 GiB, all 462 linears quantized)
            ├── Breeze-TTS-2-int8-text-encoder.safetensors (5.84 GiB, decode path bf16)
            ├── config.json
            ├── generation_config.json
            ├── tokenizer.json
            ├── tokenizer_config.json
            ├── special_tokens_map.json
            └── 📂 audio_tokenizer/                        (Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz codec, shared)
                ├── model.safetensors                      (0.64 GiB)
                ├── config.json
                ├── configuration.json
                └── preprocessor_config.json
```


Weights are research / non-commercial use only [BreezeBlue license](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Breeze TTS 2

[Breeze TTS 2](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2) is BreezeBlue's open-weight real-time TTS model: it ranks #1 among open-weight models on the Artificial Analysis TTS leaderboard and speaks natural **English and Chinese** from a single checkpoint.

## ComfyUI links
- [saganaki22/ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2](https://github.com/saganaki22/ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2)
- [drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Breeze-TTS-2-comfyui) (bf16 + int8 builds; the loader auto-downloads)

## About this workflow

Voice cloning: **Load Model** -> **Whisper Transcribe** (builds the reference transcript) -> **Voice Clone**.

**Key inputs**

- **model**: `int8-hybrid` (default - bf16 speed at ~5.5 GiB peak VRAM), `bf16` (fastest, ~7.5 GiB), `int8-convrot` (smallest, ~5.2 GiB, slower decode), `int8-text-encoder` (decode path bf16)
- **dtype / attention**: auto picks bf16 + flash_attention (falls back to sdpa); sageattention is supported
- **reference_audio / reference_text**: a clean clip and its exact transcript (the Whisper node transcribes for you)
- **text**: vocal events work inline - `(laugh)`, `(sigh)`, `(cough)`, `(clears throat)` in English, `[笑]`, `[叹气]` in Chinese
- **cfg_scale**: 1.0 clones the reference as-is; the Design/Direction nodes default to 4 for instruction-following
- **seed**: repeatable when positive, 0 keeps the current random state

Try the **Voice Design** node for reference-free synthesis and **Voice Direction** to steer a cloned voice with an instruction. Output is 24 kHz mono.

[Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2)
